summary.remediation: Use an intent-prefetch adapter on the 365 runtime links; do not re-enable viewport prefetch en masse.

policy.initial_render: prefetch={false}; no speculative viewport prefetch for dense lists or navigation surfaces.
policy.pointer_intent: On mouse hover, adapter switches prefetch to null to restore the Next.js default route-aware prefetch policy.
policy.keyboard_intent: On focus, adapter switches prefetch to null for keyboard accessibility.
policy.exclusions: Links with target other than absent/_self, download links, and hash/mailto/tel/sms destinations do not activate intent prefetch.
policy.scope: Only the 365 reviewed JSX Link nodes are wrapped; unrelated Next.js Link usages are not changed.
